purpose: nonlinear moment-fiber design: compare local tangent conditioning with full weighted-Poisson law-path conditioning under a matched Lift constraint

metric_definitions.lift_mmd2: time/scenario averaged exact discrete Gaussian-kernel MMD^2 between the I-projected law and external scientific law on the common grid
metric_definitions.full_action: time/scenario averaged weighted-Poisson minimum correction action using a mildly floored elliptic operator
metric_definitions.tangent_action: time/scenario averaged local kinetic moment-rate minimum action r^T G^{-1} r
metric_definitions.hidden_action: full_action - tangent_action; expected nonnegative in the continuum, with small discretization error allowed
metric_definitions.info_score: expected squared derivative of exact population measurements with respect to latent interior orientation alpha
